page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 8 dedicated physical cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn2.xlarge sits primarily in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench rank in the weak to poor categories. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write performance reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip compression and Passmark encryption, also register in the lower percentiles, reflecting the older architecture of the underlying Intel Xeon hardware.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.sn2.xlarge represents a resource-dense option where raw compute speed is secondary to memory capacity. It is suitable for workloads that require a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio but do not demand high-performance computing, such as basic web serving, development environments, lightweight database operations, or small-scale text processing.
